phone_ban.why: Y's consumer wait-then-grey-market reaction and FX spiral are interesting, but legal supply and FX pressure both hit 100 under an active ban, which breaks the story. X stays plausible with a clear quota turning point.

free_coder.why: X is rosy and repetitive: developers upskill every stage while employment and client hours rise despite 80% in-house AI. Y shows downturn compounding free AI, layoffs, emigration, then a partial review-services recovery.

water_ration.why: Y exposes the trade-off: protecting the reservoir by tightening drives supply hours to 28, anger and health risk up, and the utility budget toward collapse. X leans on convenient rain for a generic recovery.

truck_strike.why: X has a coherent arc: fuel cut and tariff floor lead to a deal and recovery. Y repeats the same actions for four stages; freight recovers while the strike continues; fuel is never addressed; prices climb to 93.
